parts.name: cat
sources: Quaternius, Animal Pack Vol.2 (2017): Cat.fbx. https://opengameart.org/content/animated-animales-low-poly CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
A cat of Việt Nam (mèo ta): a small short-haired cat, about 25 cm at the shoulder, gray with a white chest and white paws, a tail up.
The size of a domestic cat: about 23 to 25 cm at the shoulder, 3.5 to 4.5 kg. The gait is the walk of a cat (the same order of the feet as a dog).
